name: TwinFlow unified sampler
plain: A one-step style model loop that predicts x₀ and noise at once, then re-noises fully with fresh noise, as consistency sampling does. The model also gets a target time. The node keeps only the length of the sigmas it is given: the pack rebuilds its own schedule, using the official preset per the comment.
math:
F=(x−D)/t; ẑ=x+(1−t)F; x̂=D.
x⁺=(1−t⁺)x̂+t⁺(ẑ√(1−r)+n√r), r=stochast_ratio=1, so ẑ is dropped.
Target time: 0 for few, t for mul, t⁺ for any.
Seeded per step: seed+1+i.
label: from code
surprise: Sigmas from the graph are ignored apart from their count.
